ideas.name: Yen Intervention Aftereffect
ideas.claim: In one subsample, the first day without intervention after a day of yen-selling intervention was associated with yen appreciation. The full-sample result was insignificant.
ideas.quote: Some sample-specific evidence that the first day after intervention is associated with an adverse exchange rate adjustment is found.
ideas.mechanism: Official foreign exchange intervention and subsequent absence of intervention

rules.filters: First day without intervention immediately following an intervention day

not_stated: magnitude of the reported subsample effect
ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a statistically significant yen appreciation after yen-selling intervention in one subsample; the full sample and another subsample did not support the effect.
required_data: Daily Japanese intervention dates and direction
